resources.string: Blocks system-level shortcuts triggered by a physical keyboard (volume, power, navigation, media, function keys, Win key, system combos, etc.)
Enable the module in Vector / LSPosed and tick the \"System Framework\" scope for it to take effect.
Module is not running inside system_server. Make sure the module is enabled and the \"System Framework\" scope is ticked.
Injected into system_server (synced %1$d s ago)\nActive config: %2$s
Last sync was %1$d min ago — the module may have stopped running.
Soft-keyboard input and injected events are never affected.
Function keys: F1–F12, Esc, PrtSc, etc.
Use Android KeyEvent keycode numbers separated by commas. The allowlist always wins.

Apps stop receiving the key entirely. Side effects: a keyboard can no longer wake the device from sleep, and lock-screen keys stop working. Required to disable app-level combos such as Ctrl+W in a browser.
Apply and sync to system framework
Toggles are synced automatically — no need to tap the button.
